g.text: Light elements lower the melting point:

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #10151b

g.text: 2 wt% S melts 264 K below pure iron at the

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #10151b
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #10151b

g.text: Iron freezes where the core temperature falls

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #10151b

g.text: below the liquidus. In this example pure iron

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #10151b

g.text: forms an inner core from 201 GPa (shaded).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #10151b

g.text: With 2 wt% S the core stays liquid.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #10151b

g.text: Every Fe-S liquidus lies in the shaded band

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #10151b

g.text: between pure iron and the eutectic.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #10151b

g.text: Above 330 GPa there are no data. The code

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #10151b
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #10151b

g.text: Below 15 GPa the measured Fe-S liquidus is not

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #10151b

g.text: ideal. The curve misses it by 79 to 153 K
